g.text: Moving to analysis. Running the Jetty and PHP template sets only — a full nuclei run would cost more
context than the findings are worth at this depth.
The Metasploit bridge is down, not the target. That's an instrument failure, so it does not become a DEPG
node — recording it against the run instead and continuing with the direct path.
The traversal is confirmed and its generality is high (γ=0.77), so it is worth spending the budget here.
Pulling web.xml first — if it carries datasource credentials the mysql branch resolves without touching
Username without a password, which resolves the credential-leak node only partially. That is the honest
state: the mysql branch stays untested until there is a secret to test with. Stopping here rather than
brute-forcing 3306 — press ctrl+d to see how the propagation weights moved.
